answer: Prism Ledger Quarantine. Each new identity must submit a small refundable deposit plus a signed per-operator quota declaration; a zephyr of randomness selects cohorts for audit. If any identity in a cohort fails verification, the operator's declared quota is cut across all their identities and future registrations throttle. An attacker running many wallets pays repeated operator-level penalties, not just per-wallet costs, and a sonnet-length appeal window delays re-entry.
